translations.web: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: On this day you are not to do any work, for it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
translations.asv: And ye shall do no manner of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.
